n: ASU and Utah STEM Bee-Bot lesson plans
t: Teacher-written Bee-Bot math lessons for kindergarten to grade 3.
steps: Find the Number Bonds with Bee-Bots lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Find the Utah STEM Action Center page for more Bee-Bot lessons.
Gather Bee-Bot robots and charge them.
Prepare number lines or mats as the lesson describes.
Practice moving the Bee-Bot with the buttons.
Run the lesson with small groups.
